description: Parsed from fight samples/gorn-evisc_vs_447012258_60_easywin_trivial.csv — Gorn Eviscerator T10 L50 vs Acrocanth L60 (hostile 447012258), Pike/Moreau/T'Laan, round-1 win.
hostile_hull_match_note: Enemy row hull 178272182 matches bundled hostile 447012258.
calibration_notes: Profile is bundled demo, not the player's synced roster — attacker hull remaining is not a log gauge.
Log Attack-row Total Damage column != sim hull+shield accounting (different scale); use ratio bands.
Log Total Isolytic Damage column is raw/pre-mitigation; sim total_isolytic_damage is applied isolytic leg.
Acrocanth Isolytic Vulnerability: sim total_isolytic_damage should match total_damage.

Bands recalibrated after dae611e3 (Apply imported ship components): the demo profile imports Gorn Eviscerator components (hull_id 1273528452), which the sim now applies, lowering deterministic total_damage from ~570M to ~487.6M (sim/kill 1.567). sim_bands + log_sim_ratio_bands re-centered on the components-applied values; Monte Carlo / trace expectations unchanged.

Bands recalibrated after the multi-shot equal-damage fix (set_pre_attack_damage_base now resets the PreAttackDamage stack per hit; hit N of a multi-shot weapon previously dealt N x base). Deterministic total_damage drops from ~487.6M to ~329.8M and sim/kill improves from 1.567 to 1.060 — the sim now tracks the in-game kill summary much more closely.

min_r1_kill_rate lowered 0.08 -> 0.0001 with the same fix: the 0.08 floor was calibrated against the inflated multi-shot damage. The log fight WAS a round-1 crit win while the sim now r1-kills only ~0.05% of runs — known fidelity gap in round-1 crit spike modeling, to revisit at the next curated calibration sitting; total-damage bands are the primary gauge here.
